entries.note: Rust observation calculus. Local Cargo.toml declares only the two deps the library uses (serde, quick-xml) and does not build the CLI.

Subset: the browser-only SBML/three.js helpers and the unused TypeScript compiler tree are not vendored. index.js appends re-exports (compileSBS, validateSBS, SCRIPTS, DEFAULT_SCRIPT, solveCircuit, computeFluxPattern, extractMetrics) after the upstream body; package.json adds the ./scripts export and relies on the host for d3.
Byte-identical up to line endings. The package.json one level up (vendor/hfq/package.json) is local: upstream ships none.
Build product: `npm run build` in pylon/ts, then copy ts/dist and package.json (scripts/devDependencies stripped). Verified byte-identical to a fresh build of ts/src at this commit (2026-09-28).
Host infrastructure, not a module: the residue-driven scheduler, driven through registry-ts's scheduler port (spec 08). Copied 2026-07-01 without provenance; recorded here.
Local Cargo.toml sets autobins = false (the `zangalewa` CLI is not built here).
Only chi.rs is vendored; lib.rs and purpose.rs in the vendored crate are a local shim (index schema only, no process spawning).
The differential oracle corpora (tokens/ast/eval/graph .json) and their harnesses; run in-workspace as the engine's own conformance suite.

The canonical Agent Smith front end (parser + typechecker + town). NOT smith-ide/src/compiler, which is a self-declared regex stub, and not crates/agent-smith (Rust), which lags the JS (singleton-cut floor, short potential list). The adapter imports only compile.js and town.js.

The TypeScript synopsis front end (tokeniser, parser, Stage-B checker). Upstream ships no evaluator, by design (IDE-PLAN.md); the module checks and reports, it does not run. The Rust twin (synopsis/rs) is parse-only and is not bound. package.json one level up is local.
The conformance corpus (positive + negative programs with expected error classes), extracted from the Python reference; the module tests run it.

The JS port of the cause-for-concern reference (prototype/cfc, Python): lexer, parser, kernel, interpreter, seeded sweeps. Parity with the Python reference was checked on all four Python examples (status, clock, verdicts, holonomies, witness sets). package.json one level up is local.
The five example programs the upstream IDE ships; the module test runs them all.

The st-Hurbert repo-query language (lexer, parser, interpreter) and the model it navigates (model.ts, chi.ts, lineage.ts; github.ts for types only, its fetch code is never reached from the language). Excluded: the LLM front door (ai.ts), the analysis orchestrator and the engine transport. Same commit as tracker-chi; chi.ts is thrust's TS port of the chi.rs that tracker vendors (specs/sthurbert.md section 7).

The committed zero-dependency ESM bundle of honjo/src (lexer, parser, checker, Cut-IR lowering, shell derivation Z=1..118, interpreter), which is what the honjo web app runs. It is four lines AHEAD of its TypeScript source (a `shells` field in individuate; U-hjo-1). package.json is local.
The four .hj example programs; the module test runs them all.

The two language front ends of the heihachi micro-kernel: mishima (.mma) and sangoma (.sgn), their shared lexer, the Diagnostic/CheckResult shape and composite_power. Pure (serde, thiserror). The daemon crate itself (tokio, axum, reqwest, CLAP host, file watching) is not vendored; lib.rs and Cargo.toml in buhera-os/vendor/heihachi are the local shim (tracker-chi precedent).

The record graph (Runtime, Value::reading, min-cut contact graph, seek_to_closure). Vendored because lang/ and graph/ are one unit upstream (graph::reach imports lang::mishima) and graph/ carries tests the module relies on; the adapter does not yet drive a Runtime (the run orchestration lives in the daemon's HTTP handler, U-hei-1).
recall.mma and reese.sgn, the two upstream example programs; the module's demos and tests use them verbatim (include_str!).

Pure, deterministic core of the Olduvai exchange: ternary S-coordinate addresses, the prefix trie with honest fallback, water-filling, foreman cycle coherence. Recorded at origin/main (a7b520d): the local clone is 9 commits ahead, but this path is identical at both. Local Cargo.toml (upstream uses workspace keys).

Partition states (n,l,m,s), backward trajectory completion, per-residue S-entropy coordinates. Recorded at origin/main (the local clone's 3 unpushed commits do not touch crates/). Local Cargo.toml declares only serde and thiserror: upstream also declares nalgebra, num-traits, num-complex and rand, which the library never uses and which (rand → getrandom) block wasm32 (U-lev-1). levinthal-msms and levinthal-folding are deliberately not vendored (U-lev-2, U-lev-3).

The web Shapeshifter interpreter (compileStage/executeStage) and purpose domains; the only implementation of the paper's generative standard library (section 9). Upgraded from 162ae1b: adds experiment.js and nine acquisition/analysis operations (additive). package.json at vendor/shapeshifter is local.
Virtual instrument, lipidomics/proteomics libraries, fragmentation (residue monoisotopic masses), adducts.
Partition addressing, S-entropy, ternary, generative DB, virtual tensor.
The db.search* network client. Imported by the compiler but never called: db.* operations return unresolved pending sentinels (specs/shapeshifter.md).

The pure numerical core of vivid-symbolism: channelisation, low-frequency spectral embedding, shader-kernel cosine top-K, FFT matched filtering with background statistics and peak picking. Excluded: locus.js (fetches genome regions), webgl.js (DOM), and the synopsis IDE copy (the synopsis module vendors the front end itself). These are the operations synopsis programs name; they are NOT a synopsis evaluator (specs/spectral.md). package.json one level up is local.

The Shakespeare ladder kernel (a port of shk_core.py): contact graphs, intensive power, multiplicative composition, the costed Machine. Vendored 2026-07 without provenance (long-grass c648362); recorded here at origin/main, where it is identical up to line endings. package.json at vendor/ladder is local (its UNLICENSED field predates this entry; upstream levinthal is MIT).

The Mekaneck (.mck) language: lexer, LL(1) parser, type checker, small-step evaluator, and its fixtures test. Cargo.toml is local (upstream inherits workspace keys; thiserror 2 is declared directly). The upstream layout under buhera-os/vendor/mekaneck is kept so tests/fixtures.rs finds ../../web/.../fixtures.json.
Residual algebra: derived floors, catalytic power, multiplicative composition, closure (Cell, Outcome). Cargo.toml is local.
The Rust-generated diagnostic fixtures (exact line/column) that pin the TS mirror to the Rust front end; the vendored lang crate's own fixtures test reads them.
coherence.mck, sleep_cardiac.mck, cardiac_quantum.mck; the module's demo and tests use them verbatim.

The SCOPE compiler (lexer, parser, type checker with depth, overlap, entropy-budget and grounding analyses) and runtime (observe, catalyze, access, measure, visualise; session REPL). Vendored 2026-07-20 without provenance; recorded here, byte-identical. runtime/ carries ~1.8 kLOC of legacy executors and API clients (fetch, NEXT_PUBLIC_HF_TOKEN) unreachable from index.ts (U-scp-1). package.json and tsconfig.json one level up are local.
